questions.q: Which firmware replaces BLHeli_S on 8-bit ESCs to get bidir DShot?
questions.explain: Bluejay is open-source firmware for the same EFM8 ESCs; it adds bidir DShot and EDT.

questions.q: What does the ESC transmit with bidirectional DShot?
options: The battery voltage instead of throttle
questions.explain: The ESC replies with eRPM; this is the input of the RPM filter and of the ESC-based notch.

questions.q: A 14-pole motor, the ESC reports 70,000 eRPM. Mechanical RPM?
What does EDT add to the DShot replies?
options: Encryption of the whole flight controller → ESC channel
questions.explain: Extended DShot Telemetry transmits the ESC's status without a separate wire.

questions.q: What do you risk by flashing an ESC with someone else's target?
options: Only a reset of the startup tune
It not working, or burned switches
Losing bidir DShot until a reboot
questions.explain: A target describes a specific board; a wrong one can destroy the ESC.

questions.q: A motor twitches and stops on a sharp throttle input. What do you adjust first in the ESC?
questions.explain: This is a loss of synchronization; it is cured by raising demag compensation and lowering the timing.

questions.q: Why doesn't passthrough in ArduPilot work on the MAIN outputs?
options: MAIN does not support DShot at all
They are IOMCU outputs, FMU/AUX are needed
questions.explain: The IOMCU coprocessor's outputs do not pass the signal through; use FMU/AUX.

options: It was opened under the GPL
questions.explain: BLHeli_32 is no longer developed; for ARM ESCs with a target there is an open-source replacement — AM32.
